business_problem: Transforming Toyota Safety Connect with MongoDB Atlas to overcome legacy challenges for Toyota Connected In a life-and-death situation, every second counts.
solution_summary: Transforming Toyota Safety Connect with MongoDB Atlas to overcome legacy challenges for Toyota Connected In a life-and-death situation, every second counts. The company migrated to MongoDB Atlas. When the company needed a reliable, resilient database solution to support this platform, it turned to MongoDB. “Every message matters, and in an emergency, there’s no time to waste,” said Kevin O’Dell, Director of Engineering at Toyota Connected. MongoDB is an active partner in the AWS ISV Workload Migration Program, where it is committed to streamlining the migration process for customers who transfer self-managed workloads to the cloud. In 2022, amid a four-month migration to AWS, Toyota Connected’s migration to MongoDB Atlas was one of the simplest pieces to manage, according to O’Dell. “Having MongoDB as a cross-cloud platform was very beneficial to us,” said O’Dell.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides the managed document database backing Toyota Connected's modernized application platform.

data_flow: Operational data from legacy or distributed applications is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, where flexible document models support microservices, APIs, and downstream user experiences without batch-heavy synchronization. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS.
business_outcome: 99.99% availability achieved Improved resiliency and reliability Increased company-wide efficiency
